name: Tombstone Begins

features.name: Sticky Win Respins
features.description: Winning symbols and their copies stay put.

features.name: Unleash
features.description: All revolvers fire their remaining bullets.

review:
The Tombstone prequel on a 4-5-5-5-4 grid, built on sticky Win Respins: winning symbols – and every other copy of them on the grid – stay put while the rest respins.

Revolvers fire bullets across the board; an Unleash symbol makes them fire every remaining shot, and a Refill reloads them to six. xSplit and xNudge show up too. Extreme volatility, 20,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
